[[File:SylvarsRobe-KOTOR2.jpg|thumb|Sylvar's robe.]]
This '''[[Jedi apparel/Legends|robe]]''' once belonged to the [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Sylvar]], a fellow student of future [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]]. Though her mate, [[Crado]], fell under Kun's sway and into [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|darkness]], she remained true to the light and became a strong voice within the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. Her robe provided some protection against energy as well as the dark side, in addition to providing increased mobility.

These robes were possibly found by the [[Meetra Surik|Jedi Exile]] some time in [[3951 BBY]], during the [[First Jedi Purge]].

==Behind the scenes==
In the game, only a character whose alignment is [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light-sided]] can wear the robe.
